tldr: Colombia experienced a devastating 7.4-magnitude earthquake, resulting in over 130 fatalities and widespread structural damage.
An exiled Syrian court issued a death sentence in absentia to former President Bashar al-Assad for war crimes committed during the civil war.
Geopolitical tensions between the U.S. and Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz talks led to a surge in oil prices and contributed to rising Treasury yields.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both declined at their most recent close on 2026-08-10, with oil prices surging as talks between the U.S. and Iran stalled over the Strait of Hormuz, creating economic uncertainty.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.7% at its most recent close on 2026-08-10, as investors awaited upcoming inflation data and reacted to ongoing tensions with Iran, which contributed to higher oil prices.

vix.why: The VIX increased to 15.46 at its most recent close on 2026-08-10, reflecting heightened market uncertainty driven by stalled talks between the U.S. and Iran over the Strait of Hormuz and related increases in oil prices.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Anthropic's AI model, Claude, will begin applying invisible watermarks to both generated text and images, adhering to European AI transparency regulations.
Mathematicians are reportedly engaging in "soul searching" as the discipline grapples with the accelerating influence of artificial intelligence on the field.
Joby Aviation, a developer of electric aircraft, announced a $500 million acquisition of defense firm Resonant Sciences to expand its presence in the military sector.

world.summary: A powerful 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, resulting in at least 130 deaths and significant damage to buildings in cities like Cali and Pereira.
A Syrian court has sentenced former President Bashar al-Assad and his brother Maher to death in absentia for war crimes and crimes against humanity committed during the country's 14-year civil war.
